import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Use the AM-GM inequality: for non-negative reals, the geometric mean is at most the arithmetic mean
  -- The arithmetic mean is (∑ a x) / n = n / n = 1
  -- Therefore the geometric mean (∏ a x)^(1/n) ≤ 1, which implies ∏ a x ≤ 1^n = 1
  have h₁ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ (∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x) / n := by
    -- Apply the AM-GM inequality from Mathlib
    apply Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted_with_zero
    <;> simp_all [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    <;> norm_num
    <;> aesop
  
  -- Since the sum equals n, the arithmetic mean is 1
  have h₂ : (∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x : ℝ) / n = 1 := by
    rw [h₀]
    field_simp
    <;> cases n <;> simp_all
  
  -- Combine to get the geometric mean ≤ 1
  have h₃ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ (∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x) / n := h₁
      _ = 1 := by rw [h₂]
  
  -- If the nth root is ≤ 1, then the product itself is ≤ 1
  have h₄ : ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · -- If n = 0, both sides are empty products/sums
      simp [hn]
    · -- For n > 0, use the fact that x^(1/n) ≤ 1 implies x ≤ 1 for x ≥ 0
      have h₅ : n ≠ 0 := hn
      have h₆ : 0 ≤ ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x := by
        apply Finset.prod_nonneg
        intro i _
        exact a i
      -- Use the monotonicity of the power function
      have h₇ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₈ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x : ℝ) > 1 := by linarith
        have h₉ : ((∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ)) > 1 := by
          apply Real.one_lt_rpow
          · linarith
          · have h₁₀ : (1 / n : ℝ) > 0 := by
              apply div_pos
              · norm_num
              · exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h₅)
            linarith
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h₇
  
  exact h₄
